about: THE RANCH ROAD (route R8, One World BUILD_PLAN phase 4.2, 2026-11-17): a dirt road from the Estate's Ranch (the Windmill's east side) east across cattle country and south to Western Town's north edge. Its first plot (-10,18) is a field of the Ranch's own room (bake-estate.js, rule 4), so this room starts at plot 1. Its own room: two zones never join. The design page: 'cattle ranges and a crop circle, into Western Town'.
